title: Anniversary Commitment Review and Tier Changes under the Contract Pricing Agreement
content:
Anniversary commitment review — Contract Pricing Agreement

At each agreement anniversary the agreement's trailing 12 month qualifying spend, measured on the tier's commitment measurement basis, is compared with the agreement's commitment. The trailing window is the 12 calendar months ending on the day before the anniversary, and qualifying spend there is the same basis the volume rebate uses: invoiced merchandise on the customer's Commercial Credit Account for order shipments, StockSmart replenishments and VendPoint usage, less special-order lines shipped and less return credits, summed over the window.

**Shortfall.** When that spend is below the tier's shortfall review threshold percent of the commitment, the agreement moves down one tier, to the tier named below, effective on the anniversary, with that tier's commitment. Contract items above the lower tier's largest item count are removed with notice under the contract item list rules, and a lower tier with no contract items reverts every item to its discount basis. A tier whose shortfall review threshold is 0 is never reviewed for shortfall.

| Current tier | Tier moved to on a shortfall |
|---|---|
| Corbett Account Price Schedule | Corbett Account Price Schedule |
| Corbett Volume Discount Agreement | Corbett Account Price Schedule |
| Corbett Category Contract | Corbett Volume Discount Agreement |
| Corbett Net-Price Contract | Corbett Category Contract |
| Corbett Cost-Plus Contract | Corbett Net-Price Contract |
| Corbett Strategic Supply Agreement | Corbett Net-Price Contract |

**Moving up.** A move up to a higher tier is made only by a signed amendment when the customer's trailing 12 month spend meets that tier's entry gate. A tier change never restarts the term.

**Worked example (hypothetical figures).** Commitment 100000.00, threshold 80 percent: trailing spend of 79999.99 is below 80000.00 and the agreement moves down; trailing spend of exactly 80000.00 is not below it and the agreement stays at its tier.
